title: Stalk maps of morphisms of schemes: germs and composition
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $x\in X$; for a morphism $h$ and a point $w$ write $h^\sharp_w$ for the induced map of local rings $\mathcal O_{\cdot,h(w)}\to\mathcal O_{\cdot,w}$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], and $f^\sharp_W:\mathcal O_Y(W)\to\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}W)$ for the map on sections over an open $W\subseteq Y$. (a) For every open $W\subseteq Y$ with $f(x)\in W$ and every $t\in\mathcal O_Y(W)$, $f^\sharp_x(t_{f(x)})=\bigl(f^\sharp_W(t)\bigr)_x$ (germs as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]). (b) $(g\circ f)^\sharp_x=f^\sharp_x\circ g^\sharp_{f(x)}:\mathcal O_{Z,g(f(x))}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$.
